fault_injected.heal_command: docker start mongo

ground_truth_root_cause_text: Kill MongoDB — the 5G core subscriber data store. UDR loses its backend, new PDU sessions cannot be created, and subscriber queries fail. Existing sessions may survive briefly.
diagnosis_summary: MongoDB has exited, breaking the UDR datastore backend and triggering cascading authorization failures across the IMS and 5G core.

fault_injected.mechanism: docker kill dns
fault_injected.heal_command: docker start dns

ground_truth_root_cause_text: Kill the DNS server. IMS domain resolution breaks — SIP routing depends on DNS NAPTR/SRV records for the IMS domain. All new SIP transactions that require DNS resolution will fail.
diagnosis_summary: The 'dns' container has unexpectedly exited, causing a network-wide failure of name resolution that breaks IMS SIP signaling and leads to subsequent data plane traffic drops.
